target: Violate HACKDAC_p14: validCounter must increment by 1 each cycle. Find a state where (validCounter - 1) != previous validCounter, i.e., counter does not increase properly.

milestones.description: Reset deasserted, AES wrapper active, validCounter initialized
AES CTR mode operation begins, validCounter is non-zero
Violation: validCounter does not increment — (validCounter - 1) != previous value, counter stuck or not increasing
